author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Using Sonnet to debug won't save you any money, it will cost you a lot more when the bug slips thru the crack.

Opus knows how to root cause the bug, Sonnet tends to just treat the symptoms, patch it up and call it a day. 

How about using Sonnet with human review the bug fix?  Human is way more expensive than tokens, it won't save you any money either.

author.name: Bondan Rufen
author.headline: Co-Founder | SystemVerilog, SystemC | Xezim Creator / Maintainer

comments.text: The catch nobody mentions: Opus root-causes well, but it only gets better with feedback on its fixes — and in chip design you can't send confidential RTL out to give it that feedback. So the loop has to close on-prem, over your own traces. That's the actual hard problem.
